description: Photograph of a Georgia O'Keeffe painting depicting the view outside her Abiquiu house. Painting is being held upright by a hand belonging to an out-of-frame individual. Handwritten in blue ink on verso: "Picture - no. I//On loan//Nov. 8, 1966//Anita." Stamped on verso: "304B."
title: Georgia O'Keeffe painting
